mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% indicates labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signal broad economic slowdown, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST are below their 12-month moving averages (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 3.0% with rising trend (3-month increase > 0.5%) signals active monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0% and rises by more than 0.5% over 3 months (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market indicated by monthly payroll gains above 100,000 drives consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 100,000 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1,500,000 units signal weak residential demand, reducing construction activity and related sector revenues, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is below 1500.0 (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: High CPI index (CPIAUCSL > 260.0) combined with elevated unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) indicates stagflation, eroding corporate margins and consumer purchasing power, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 260.0 and UNRATE exceeds 5.0% (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly real GDP decline (GDPC1 growth < 0%) signals recession, reducing corporate earnings and investor confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth is negative (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).
